entities.summary: Lidia Teresa Chmielnicka-Żmuda was a former female Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1963–1968, bronze medalist of Olympic Games Mexico 1968 and silver medalist of European Championship, eight-time Polish Champion.
